title: Natsage
tagline: The project uses a browser wallet and frontend for acquiring NFTs of endangered Latin American species via a Unity 3D game. Collected in an album, players exchange duplicates to complete it.
description: The project will create a frontend in React that will provide users with the opportunity to acquire a pack of NFTs representing endangered species in Latin America through an interactive game powered by Unity. The NFTs can be collected in an album featured in the frontend, and the surplus ones can be exchanged as digital assets with other players via the Optimism network. The game's objective is to involve adolescents in educational processes, teaching them how to handle wallets and decentralized systems while addressing the environmental issue of species extinction in Latin America.
how_its_made:
This project uses a browser-based wallet connected to a React frontend. The frontend enables access to three different processes:

NFT Acquisition: NFTs represent endangered species in Latin America. These NFTs are acquired through an interactive RPG-style game in Unity 3D. In the game, players can obtain packs containing the NFTs.

NFT Collection: The acquired packs from the game are used in this second process. The obtained NFTs are collected in an album. If there are duplicate NFTs, they can be exchanged with other players using digital assets based on a predefined set of rules. The objective is to complete the album of endangered species in Latin America.

Digital Asset Exchange: Players can collaborate and work together to exchange these digital assets in order to complete the endangered species album. This involves trading duplicate NFTs among players to help each other complete their respective albums.

the project utilizes a browser-based wallet connected to a frontend that allows the acquisition of NFTs representing endangered species in Latin America through a Unity 3D game. These NFTs are collected in an album, and duplicates are exchanged among players to complete the endangered species album.
